_note: Each fault is a deliberate bug in the app (APP_FAULTS). caught_by pins the exact tests that must fail on chromium-desktop + mobile-chrome; scripts/fault-matrix.mjs enforces it.

no_stream.what: the server buffers the whole answer and sends it at once
caught_by: answer.spec.ts: answer streams in, it does not arrive all at once
controls.spec.ts: Stop ends the answer where it is

citation_offbyone.what: citation [1] links to source 2 (an index off by one in the client)
caught_by: answer.spec.ts: every citation links to the source it numbers

double_submit.what: no in-flight guard, and the input is cleared only after the answer, so Enter then a click sends twice
caught_by: answer.spec.ts: one submit sends exactly one request, even with Enter and a click

console_error.what: a script error after each answer finishes
caught_by: a11y.spec.ts: ask page and a finished answer have no serious accessibility violations

a11y.spec.ts: the whole ask flow works from the keyboard
answer.spec.ts: a follow-up stays in the same thread and uses the earlier question

auth.spec.ts: one user cannot open another user's thread
controls.spec.ts: Regenerate replaces the answer instead of adding a second one
controls.spec.ts: a shared link opens read-only for someone who is signed out
controls.spec.ts: a stream that breaks mid-answer shows an error, and Try again gives one clean answer
devtools.spec.ts: network: the answer is a real event stream, and nothing fails or leaves the site
devtools.spec.ts: performance: page load and time to first rendered word stay within budget
navigation.spec.ts: a thread survives a reload and appears in History
navigation.spec.ts: back and forward move between pages without a reload
responsive.spec.ts: buttons are at least 44px tall on touch devices
responsive.spec.ts: no horizontal scrolling on the ask page or an answer
responsive.spec.ts: the input stays in view after an answer on a short screen
